name: google-grounded-search-copilot
description: Use Hermes Google Antigravity OAuth to run Gemini native Google Search grounding from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Prefer Google-grounded search for current facts and source-backed answers.
interface.longDescription: Google Grounded Search Copilot gives Codex a structured MCP tool for source-backed current information. The tool delegates login and token refresh to Hermes' google-antigravity provider, then forces Gemini native Google Search grounding for the search request. Codex should use it for latest/current/search/source/verification questions and keep final judgment, synthesis, and safety boundaries in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Search the latest official sources with Google grounding.
Verify this claim with source URLs.
